title: imap: EXPUNGE and CLOSE handlers
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/expunge.rs. EXPUNGE removes Deleted-flagged messages from the selected mailbox. Algorithm: (1) require Selected state; (2) reject if readonly -> tagged NO [CANNOT]; (3) query imap_flags WHERE user=X AND group=Y AND flags LIKE '%Deleted%' to get deleted CIDs; (4) for each deleted CID: delete from imap_flags; compute the sequence number of that article; send * N EXPUNGE (sequence number, not UID); (5) sequence numbers of remaining messages renumber downward (standard IMAP behavior); (6) tagged OK. Note: in usenet-ipfs v1, EXPUNGE only removes the user's view (imap_flags row), NOT the article from IPFS or the group log -- articles are immutable in IPFS. CLOSE: same as EXPUNGE followed by deselecting the mailbox (revert to Authenticated state).
